data.title: Grant of basic subsistence support in old age (Grundsicherung im Alter) from 1 December 2026
data.summary: The Sozialamt of Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald grants Annika Beispielsteiner Grundsicherung im Alter (basic subsistence support for old age) of €412.64 per month starting December 2026, after offsetting her €768.36 pension as income and covering her rent in full.
data.explanation: This letter from the Sozialamt approves your application for Grundsicherung im Alter, a state benefit that tops up a low pension. From December 2026 you will receive €412.64 each month, and your rent is covered in full because it is considered reasonable. Your pension of €768.36 was counted as income in the calculation. If you think the calculation is wrong, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Kreisverwaltung; the app shows the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final and the payments continue as described.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree with the decision
items.action: If you disagree with the benefit calculation, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to the Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald, or declare it in person at their office, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the decision becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
